photos.title: Streets of houses in Bent Oak Estates, Myrtle Beach, NOAA aerial, January 2026
photos.what: Three streets of one-story houses on small lots, close together, with short driveways and small yards, in Bent Oak Estates in the City of Myrtle Beach, seen straight down from above on January 12, 2026. Bare winter trees; brown lawns. Cars are too small to read; no person can be recognized.
photos.caption: Houses in Bent Oak Estates, Myrtle Beach, seen from above.
photos.alt: Rows of small one-story houses with gray and brown roofs, short driveways and small yards along three streets, seen from above
photos.author: NOAA National Geodetic Survey
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: NOAA National Geodetic Survey (NGS), Remote Sensing Division, Emergency Response Imagery, 2026 pre-event coastal collection, East Coast group EC2601a, flown 2026-01-12 (the same group as the records for /invest/run-the-numbers/ and /submarkets/carolina-forest/the-farm/). One map tile, EC2601a_OB_N_C0785445w334115n.tif (4707 x 4707 px, WGS 84, 2.698e-6 degrees a pixel, top left -78.9125, 33.6875), downloaded 2026-11-03 from the public S3 bucket noaa-eri-pds. Frame: pixels 633 to 1833 across and 1003 to 1903 down, not resized.
